title: LearnHub event envelope
description: Common wrapper for every message published to the 'learning.events' topic exchange. The 'type' equals the routing key.

eventId.description: Unique per event; consumers use it for idempotency.

type.description: <domain>.<event>, for example 'payment.succeeded'. Equals the routing key.

version.description: Version of the event's schema, starting at 1.

occurredAt.description: When the event happened, UTC (ISO-8601, ends with 'Z').

correlationId.description: Correlation ID of the request or event that caused this event.

payload.description: Event-specific content; defined by the owning domain, opaque to the envelope.
